fusions.name: Spark Shoal
fusions.desc: Looses a shoal of 3 sparks that spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. Each hit has a 25% chance to set the target [Burning] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Scatter the School
fusions.desc: Hurls a flame that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 2.5 tiles. It then darts to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Through the Boil
fusions.desc: You slip 2 tiles, and for 3 seconds blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You have 15% fire resistance.

fusions.name: Gleam Off the Scales
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a spark builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 17% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
